info.name: Reads the bridge token keys for a given read key.

params.name: readKey
params.description: The read key to read the bridge token keys for.

items.docs: Returns 200 with the keys when available, 202 when they are not yet available, or 404 when not found.

info.name: Creates a pair of read and write bridge token keys for a client.

params.name: clientId
params.description: The client ID to create the keys for.

items.docs: The write key stores the authentication result and the read key retrieves it.
